description: This Java class implements the service for reading capitalized income balance data associated with loans in the Fineract system. It provides methods to fetch detailed and summarized capitalized income data for a specific loan, including calculations of amortized amounts based on existing balance information.

classes.name: CapitalizedIncomeBalanceReadServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the CapitalizedIncomeBalanceReadService, providing methods to retrieve capitalized income data for loans.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeData
methods.description: Retrieves detailed capitalized income data for a specific loan, including calculations of amortized amounts.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of capitalized income details for a specific loan, including computed amortized amounts.
